scope_of_claim: Source-checked draft benchmark, not human consensus labels or formal model scores
test_policy: Use dev only for tuning; freeze models/config before 60 test cases. Source preparation agent has read the labels.
relevance_policy: Short literal anchors plus physical page; mapped source paragraph further narrows relevance after ingestion.
source_version_policy: All page numbers refer to the exact downloaded arXiv PDF version and SHA256 in corpus manifest.
